svg.title: Azure hub-and-spoke network architecture
svg.desc: Secure Azure hub-and-spoke network topology: Hub-VNet hosts Azure Firewall, Application Gateway with WAF, Azure Bastion, and Virtual Network Gateway. Production-VNet and Testing-VNet are isolated spoke VNets peered to the hub. All spoke-to-spoke and spoke-to-internet traffic routes through the hub firewall via User Defined Routes.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does traffic from the internet enter the hub-spoke topology?')
sendPrompt('How does the Virtual Network Gateway connect on-premises networks?')

g.text: Hosts all shared infrastructure services · all spoke traffic routes through here

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Application Gateway with WAF do in the hub VNet?')
sendPrompt('How does Azure Firewall enforce traffic between spokes and to the internet?')
sendPrompt('What does the Virtual Network Gateway do in hub-spoke topology?')
sendPrompt('What does Azure Bastion provide in the hub VNet?')
g.text: AzureBastionSubnet — secure RDP / SSH to spoke VMs without public IPs

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What VMs run in the Production-VNet spoke?')
sendPrompt('What VMs run in the Testing-VNet spoke?')

svg.text: Spoke-to-spoke and spoke-to-internet traffic routes through hub Azure Firewall — UDR next-hop = Firewall private IP
